notes.title: November Update - Jet Packs and Map Update
notes.notes:
Hello! There have been many small updates recently and I think it's time for a changelog thing! 

Last week: 

- New Jet Pack ability added!
- Landings has had some extra "cliff bits" added on the East section and a new spawn point right at the back in the middle. 
- Ravine has been expanded and changed around a little bit.
- The Random Challenge button on the main menu now generates a better random challenge (no more 100 vs 25 matches) 
- Abilities can now be used by clicking the mouse (they still work with the old "e" and "f" buttons if you preferred that) 
- Fixed a bug where you could still capture a base after exploding.

Today:
- Added a back button during the mission briefing which takes you back to the main menu.
- Missions 1 to 5 have no Bomber Eggs so new players can get into it easier.
- Very Low Quality setting added (this has no shadows and lowers a few textures even further)
- Auto-Deploy button added! 
- AI Medics now heal even more often but the effect radius is smaller.

Abilities 

More abilities have been added!

Currently you can pick from:
Shockwave - Blasts all nearby eggs away from you!
Smoke Screen - Creates a cloud of smoke around you which confuses nearby enemy eggs!
Flag Bearer - Temporarily drops a flag which increases nearby friendly egg's damage!
Air Strike - Calls in an Air Strike which cracks any eggs it hits! (This can crack you so make sure you get out of there quickly)

There are many more abilities planned!

notes.title: Capturing Bases and Controller Update
notes.notes:
Hello again! 

I've done a quick (but temporary) fix for the capturing bases issue! In this latest update the player will be able to capture neutral (white) bases and turn enemy bases blue. 

This is only temporary because the way bases will be captured and defended is being completely overhauled for a future update. Stay tuned for a much better base capturing experience! 

This update also has a few controller improvements / bug fixes.

- Changing and selecting a different class now works with an Xbox / Windows controller. 
- If the reinforcements are ready then you can respawn instantly by selecting a class from the list. 
- A "deadzone" added to the right stick to stop the automatic spinning that occurred when not touching the stick. 

I'm still working on getting the menus to all work with a controller but this should mean you have a much better combat experience for the time being. 

Enjoy the eggs!

notes.title: Update! Egg Classes and New Map!
notes.notes:
Hello eggs! 

This update contains many things! Mainly Egg Classes and a brand new map.

What are egg classes?

I'm glad you asked! 

Each Class has different skills and abilities. There are currently 3 different Classes in Eggs 1942 - I have plans to add more soon. 

Scout Egg
The scout egg can move fast and jump high. When moving fast you will take no damage!

Bomber Egg
The bomber egg can self destruct causing damage to nearby eggs. Health does not regenerate!

Heavy Egg
The heavy egg cannot sprint or jump very high but is larger and takes less damage from impact!

The AI and player can both spawn as each of these classes. 

What about this new map?

It's called Arena and is an... arena! It has fire, an egg audience, more fire, quite small, flat, some fire, eggs and fire! 

Anything else?
Yes! Here's a list of some other new things / fixes.

 Getting hit by bombs falling from planes now damages eggs!
 Pressing Esc doesn't just instantly quit the battle anymore, it goes to the respawn menu where you can select what class to respawn as. 
 Pressing Esc in Spectator Mode now works - no more getting stuck as a Spectator!
 Heavy Eggs now look quite rough. 
 Bomber Eggs now look quite shiny. 
 A settings menu added. 
 Some extra reading material in the "How to Play" menu.
 "R - Respawn" and "Waiting for reinforcements..." text now outlined so you can actually read it on Alps.
 "Max Score" and "Time" text in Custom Battle menu is now yellow. 
 Jump cooldown reduced to 3 seconds instead of 4.

I think that's everything! 

Enjoy the game and make some omelettes! x
